snippet.title: Deep Siren Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4058300/Deep_Siren/
